Element: Frost. VFX: a soft light (Rare, Effects.luau): the lantern nose glows red and pulses
every 2 s (the Light at Mouth), two frost sparkles wink over the antlers every 4 s (the Sparkle
at Top) and fine frost glitter drifts off them at 2.5 a second (the Emitter at Top); it bobs
gently; in the rig the icicles under each antler swing like chimes, the ears twitch and the
ice-bell tail swings, and every 10 s it prances: a hop and a full turn, the ears up, the bell
